cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: How Much Do You Know?
cards.instruction: Probe for what others know while revealing as little as possible.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You nodded so firmly at the alarm report that I nodded too. Which part has everyone heard?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I was nodding to the person taking coats. All we know is someone opened the fire exit. Were you there?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, the coats. Did anyone actually see the door open, or only hear the alarm?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's a camera facing it. They're checking that next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, check the camera. Have they got a face already, or are they still deciding which recording to play?

reason: Make a specific misunderstood copied cue shape the Drive pursuit and let B's practical information determine each subsequent tactic.
